answer: Each identity needs a sponsor to tend one juniper: the sponsor locks a 100-credit bond and stakes its relic reputation, a public record of past sponsorship; the newcomer pays 30. A false work log halves bond and reputation, bars the sponsor 10 epochs; idle reputations decay 2 per epoch, glacier-slow, so rented relics rot. One sponsor backs three at most, so 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors and 130,000 credits at risk. An honest agent pays 130 once.
